mapper.insert: insert into rag_documents (id, filename, openai_file_id, vector_store_id, byte_size, status, uploaded_by) values (#{id}, #{filename}, #{openaiFileId}, #{vectorStoreId}, #{byteSize}, #{status}, #{uploadedBy})
mapper.select: select d.id, d.filename, d.byte_size, d.status, u.name as uploaded_by_name, d.created_at from rag_documents d join users u on u.id = d.uploaded_by where d.deleted_at is null order by d.created_at desc
select id from rag_documents where deleted_at is null and status = 'in_progress'
select id, filename, openai_file_id, vector_store_id, byte_size, status, uploaded_by, created_at, deleted_at from rag_documents where id = #{id} and deleted_at is null
mapper.update: update rag_documents set status = #{status} where id = #{id} and deleted_at is null
update rag_documents set deleted_at = #{deletedAt} where id = #{id} and deleted_at is null
